def halves(g):
    g = np.array(g)
    w = g.shape[1]

    for c in range(w):

def try_rules(gin, gout):
    gin=np.array(gin); gout=np.array(gout)
    H,W = gin.shape; oh,ow = gout.shape
    res=[]
    for c in range(W):
        if c>=1 and W-c-1==ow and c==ow:
            L=gin[:,:c]; R=gin[:,c+1:]
            import itertools
            for fL in ('id','v','h','180'):
                for fR in ('id','v','h','180'):
                    A=np.array(L); B=np.array(R)
                    if 'v' in fL: A=A[::-1]
                    if 'h' in fL: A=A[:,::-1]
                    if fL=='180': A=A[::-1,::-1]
                    if 'v' in fR: B=B[::-1]
                    if 'h' in fR: B=B[:,::-1]
                    if fR=='180': B=B[::-1,::-1]
                    eq = (A==B)
                    elsecols = set(A[~eq].flatten())|set(B[~eq].flatten())
                    elsecols = {int(x) for x in elsecols}
                    ok3 = all(gout[i,j]==3 for i in range(oh) for j in range(ow) if eq[i,j])
                    okelse = all(gout[i,j]!=3 or eq[i,j] for i in range(oh) for j in range(ow))
                    elsevals = {int(gout[i,j]) for i in range(oh) for j in range(ow) if not eq[i,j]}
                    if ok3 and okelse:
                        res.append((c,fL,fR,elsevals,elsecols))
    return res
